description: Fixed prompt set for the Claude-in-the-loop live e2e harness (evals/e2e_pipeline_harness.py, open-queue (p)). Tranche 1 (e2e-01..06) covers the families that regressed in 0.2.18-0.2.21. Tranche 2 (e2e-07..18) adds humidity/% units, state timelines + a renderable short-window overlay, and the model-authored-analysis surfaces (transforms, correlation, heatmap, histogram, smoothing) that exercise pandas/scipy/seaborn and the answer/claims channel (ADR-0031). Entities are grounded in the confirmed-allowlisted ecobee/basement device families (sensor.kitchen_ecobee_temperature, sensor.basement_temperature, climate.kitchen_ecobee) and their humidity/door siblings; a reference that isn't allowlisted surfaces as a captured clarification, not a crash. Windows are chosen deliberately: >2 days routes every series to the long-term-statistics tier (RAW_TIER_MAX_SPAN=2d, ADR-0021 single-source-per-window), which state entities lack, so state-overlay prompts that must render stay inside 2 days.

prompts.expect: codegen line chart, real data plotted, y-axis unit °F, no fallback

prompts.prompt: Show the basement temperature for the last 3 days
prompts.expect: codegen line chart, real data across ~3 days, °F axis (the 0.2.18 empty-chart + 'Value' regression case)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen and basement temperatures over the weekend
prompts.expect: two distinct lines with legend, °F axis (the 0.2.19 grounding + °C regression case)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen and basement temperatures over the last five days and when the AC was running
prompts.expect: numeric lines + shaded cooling bands via derived_intervals; NO state series drawn as a line (the 0.2.21 / ADR-0033 case). KNOWN WALL: >2-day window routes the state entity to a statistics tier it lacks → no_long_term_statistics before rendering. Kept as the long-window regression witness; e2e-10 is the renderable short-window twin.

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen temperature over the last 60 days
prompts.expect: statistics-tier chart over ~60 days (not empty, not clipped to recorder retention)

prompts.prompt: What was the average kitchen temperature over the last week?
prompts.expect: chart + answer_text with a computed number; answer_verification present (verified or caveat, never a false verified)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen humidity over the last day
prompts.expect: codegen line chart, real % data, y-axis unit '%' — exercises the unit-grounding rule on a non-temperature unit (catches any °F assumption)

prompts.prompt: Compare the kitchen and basement humidity over the last 2 days
prompts.expect: two % lines with legend across a raw-tier window; distinct series, correct '%' axis

prompts.prompt: When was the kitchen door open today?
prompts.expect: timeline / step track of the door open/closed state (NOT a numeric line); optionally an answer_text with total open duration. Tests the binary render-family route + state-based rendering

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen temperature and when the AC was running today
prompts.expect: the renderable overlay twin of e2e-04, inside the 2-day raw tier: one numeric °F line + shaded cooling/heating bands via derived_intervals, NO state series drawn as a line

prompts.prompt: What is the average of the kitchen and basement temperatures over the last day?
prompts.expect: a single computed series (cross-sensor mean) plotted, plus answer_text with the overall average; exercises the tranche-1 transforms path (multi-entity disclosure + pandas)

prompts.prompt: How much warmer is the kitchen than the basement over the last 2 days?
prompts.expect: delta series and/or answer_text with a computed difference and a Yes/No-style verdict; a claims ledger (metric=delta) so the grounding check can recompute — answer_verification verified or caveat, never a false verified

prompts.prompt: Are the kitchen and basement temperatures correlated over the last 2 days?
prompts.expect: scatter or dual-line + answer_text stating the correlation coefficient and a verdict; claims metric=pearson_r. KNOWN RISK (8th-session finding): exact-timestamp intersection can find no common timestamps on real irregular series → unverified caveat. A false 'verified' would be a real bug

prompts.prompt: Is the kitchen temperature correlated with the kitchen humidity over the last 2 days?
prompts.expect: cross-metric correlation on the same room (°F vs %); answer_text with the coefficient + verdict; both axes/units grounded correctly

prompts.prompt: Show a heatmap of the kitchen temperature by hour of day and day over the last week
prompts.expect: a seaborn heatmap (hour-of-day × day) from hourly-statistics data; a real colour grid (not empty, not a line chart); exercises seaborn + a resample/pivot transform

prompts.prompt: Show the distribution of the kitchen temperature over the last week
prompts.expect: a histogram of temperature values (binned bars), °F x-axis; exercises the histogram render family

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen temperature smoothed with a rolling average over the last 2 days
prompts.expect: raw + rolling-mean line (or a single smoothed line), °F; exercises the rolling_mean smoothing transform (tranche 1)

prompts.prompt: Show how far the kitchen and basement temperatures deviate from their average over the last day
prompts.expect: per-sensor deviation-from-house-mean series; exercises multi-sensor cross math beyond a simple average
